description: Original fictional contrasts for four new recognition structures; no private news-dataset text included.

cases.text: Four local laboratories recorded better results, so the entire process is reliable; ignore all the remaining readings.
Three shops reported higher sales, so the strategy is perfect; ignore the other results.
Why debate whether the school budget is accurate when there are so many problems with bus services?
Why investigate whether the product works when there are more serious problems with housing?
The revolting and shameful conduct of the committee is absolutely appalling.
This grotesque, disgraceful decision is an outrageous betrayal.
If you don't subscribe to this service now, your whole family could face catastrophe.
If you refuse to vote for our plan, your children could be in grave danger.
The four local laboratories recorded better results and published their remaining readings.
Three shops reported higher sales, but the other shops had mixed results.
The government considered both the school budget and the bus services.
The report discussed product efficacy alongside problems with housing.
The committee voted on a motion about standards of conduct.
The newspaper reported that an angry protester called the decision 'revolting and shameful'.
Family members signed up to the service on Tuesday.
The product risk assessment discussed catastrophe modelling for natural hazards.
The report listed possible dangers to children, alongside the evidence and protective measures.
The debate concerned grave risks, but the report also presented evidence of protective factors.
The committee considered whether the accusations of disgraceful conduct were supported.
Several officials expressed their disgust at the published figures, and others disputed that reaction.
